baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun قُلُوب and its predicate وَاجِفَة directly pair the human center with disturbance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The heart branch includes the bodily and cognitive-affective center, while the wajf branch includes agitation, palpitation, and fear; the predicate therefore makes interior disturbance the ayah's event rather than merely naming an external danger.

activation_trace.role: The literal heart and the understanding or spirit represented by it supply the affected interior center.
Agitation and cardiac palpitation supply the center's rapid, fear-marked bodily state.

changed_reading.before: A generic statement that people are afraid.
changed_reading.after: The bodily and cognitive-affective centers themselves are in palpable internal disturbance on that day.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلُوب can retain the root's turning image, and وَاجِفَة can retain the speed of wajif motion.
baseline_models.mechanism: A center defined by turning from face to face is coupled to the rapid gait imposed on a mount. This yields a dynamic model in which the hearts are not only frightened but being turned and driven at speed.

activation_trace.role: Turning, reversal, and redirection supply an interior center undergoing a change of orientation.
The rapid gait of a driven mount supplies compelled speed to that reorientation.

changed_reading.before: A static emotional label: trembling hearts.
changed_reading.after: Human centers are being rapidly reoriented, as though carried through an imposed transition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus ayah places the heart beside a wajf form, while the wajf inventory includes affect carrying a heart away.
baseline_models.mechanism: The idiom of love taking or carrying off the heart opens a form-distant affective branch: وَاجِفَة may evoke a center seized by an overwhelming affect, not only a center displaying fear.

activation_trace.role: The literal and affective heart supplies the object capable of being emotionally taken over.
The expression in which love goes off with the heart supplies affective capture as an exploratory shade of wajf.

changed_reading.after: An overpowering affect has taken hold of, and in that sense carried off, the human center.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening chain moves from removal and exhaustive reach through rapid extraction, sustained motion, outstripping, and directed management. Against that chain, the focus heart's turning and wajf-speed become an interior phase of an ordered, compelled process rather than random panic.

activation_trace.role: Reversal and redirection make the heart a center capable of being turned by the surrounding process.
Rapid mounted motion gives the heart's state the same driven cadence as the opening sequence.
Uprooting something from its settled place supplies the process's initial displacement.
Exhaustive engulfment makes that displacement total rather than partial.
Rapid pulling and removal supply release into accelerated motion.
Running or swimming supplies sustained traversal after extraction.
Advancing and racing supply the outstripping phase of the kinetic chain.
Managing an affair by considering its outcome makes the acceleration directed rather than chaotic.

structural_cues: 79:1-5 forms a repeated participial sequence whose actions progress before the focus scene begins.
The shift from the managed opening motion to the day-scene lets exterior kinetics recur inside the heart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive images of removal, total reach, rapid release, traversal, precedence, and management; I supply the arrow that treats them as one ordered process whose human interior correlate is wajf. A live alternative is that the opening sequence only establishes atmosphere and does not act on the hearts.

changed_reading.before: The hearts palpitate because a frightening scene surrounds them.
changed_reading.after: The hearts are caught inside the surah's compelled acceleration, rapidly turned as one stage of a managed transition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deictic day of the focus follows a severe shaking and a second event that follows upon it. Wajf becomes the body's internal aftershock: external sequential disturbance is registered as cardiac and cognitive agitation.

activation_trace.role: The bodily and cognitive heart supplies the interior register of the preceding events.
Agitation and palpitation convert large-scale shaking into a somatic response.
The day's calamitous event supplies the referential and affective load taken up by يومئذ.
Severe disturbance supplies the external-scale oscillation echoed by the heart.
Continuity and succession make the disturbance a sequence rather than a single isolated shock.
One thing arriving behind another supplies the second impulse that keeps the interior response unsettled.

structural_cues: يومئذ in 79:8 points back to يوم in 79:6 across the two-event sequence.
The adjacent feminine predicates راجفة, رادفة, واجفة create a formal chain of event, successor, and bodily response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a severe disturbance, explicit succession, and cardiac agitation; I infer a scale-transfer from event to body and call the heart-state an aftershock. The live alternative is simple temporal co-occurrence without causal transmission.

changed_reading.before: The heart independently feels fear on judgment day.
changed_reading.after: The heart somatically echoes a paired external convulsion, carrying the event's succession inside the person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus presents rapid interior motion, while the next ayah presents eyes lowered into submission. The person is split into a mobile inner center and a visibly collapsed outward gaze; fear is rendered as opposed bodily vectors rather than one undifferentiated state.

activation_trace.role: The heart as bodily and inward faculty supplies the hidden pole of the contrast.
Palpitating disturbance gives the inward pole rapid motion.
Physical sight supplies the exposed outward organ paired with the hidden hearts.
Lowering and submission give the outward gaze a downward vector opposed to inward agitation.

structural_cues: 79:8-9 are adjacent nominal clauses pairing plural organs with singular feminine predicates.
The possessive in أَبْصَارُهَا carries the heart-description forward into the owners' visible gaze.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward palpitation and lowered eyesight; I infer a coordinated counter-motion within one embodied subject. A live alternative is that the two clauses merely list independent symptoms.

changed_reading.before: Trembling is a general emotional condition.
changed_reading.after: The interior races while the exterior gaze drops, exposing fear through opposed bodily motions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers question being returned to a first condition and call the recurrence a loss; one rebuking cry then makes the transition immediate. The heart's root-image of reversal and wajf-speed become the felt enactment of the very return that speech had held at a skeptical distance.

activation_trace.role: Turning something from one face to another supplies the interior mechanics of return.
Rapid driven movement supplies the sudden pace at which the reversal is realized.
Return to a thing or place states the transition the speakers question.
Return to the beginning sharpens the questioned destination as an original condition.
Repetition and coming back after a prior time turn return into recurrence.
A forceful rebuking sound supplies the efficient impulse that ends deliberation.
Numerical oneness compresses the transition into one sufficient impulse.

structural_cues: 79:10-12 use skeptical questions and quoted assessment; 79:13-14 answer with restriction and sudden فَإِذَا.
The branchless surface بِالسَّاهِرَةِ in 79:14 marks the abrupt achieved state without supplying a branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questioned return, recurrence, one coercive sound, and abrupt arrival; I infer that the focus heart is already undergoing this reversal and that its wajf is the transition's felt velocity. The live alternative is that the heart's fear precedes but does not embody the return.

changed_reading.before: The hearts fear a future resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The hearts are already being rapidly flipped into the returned state their owners had verbally denied.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context separates raw agitation from moral direction. Transgressive overflow and preference for the nearer life follow one orientation; reverent fear and restraint of the self's inclination follow another. The turning heart in 79:8 is therefore an activated pivot whose bodily fear does not by itself disclose which orientation was chosen.

activation_trace.role: Turning and redirection make the heart a locus at which orientation can reverse.
Fear-marked agitation supplies a bodily state that still requires moral interpretation.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies one possible settled orientation.
Fear joined to awe supplies a guided form of fear distinct from undirected panic.
Preference by choice supplies the decision that fixes the transgressive orientation.
Dread of expected harm supplies fear that can motivate a different course.
Restraint from action converts fear into an inhibitory moral function.
The self's inward reason and apprehension supply the interior field in which restraint works.
Inclination of the self supplies the vector that restraint opposes.

structural_cues: The invitation in 79:18-19 moves from purification and guidance to خشية, so fear can be an achieved orientation rather than mere collapse.
The balanced alternatives in 79:37-41 classify by prior transgression or restraint, not by the bare presence of fear at 79:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed trajectories of excess and restraint plus distinct fear terms; I infer that wajf is pre-verdict activation and that the heart is a pivot rather than an automatic moral label. A live alternative is that the indefinite hearts in 79:8 refer only to the transgressive branch.

changed_reading.before: Trembling identifies an already condemned class.
changed_reading.after: Trembling exposes an activated human center; its moral meaning depends on whether desire ruled it or reverent fear had already turned it toward restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first pairs deliberate darkening with bringing daylight out, then pairs the compelling arrival with recovered memory, exposure, and sight. The heart's turning is thereby epistemic: what could remain dark, outside awareness, or concealed is inverted into recollection and visibility, and wajf is the disturbance of that forced disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Turning from one face to another supplies the reversal from concealed to manifest awareness.
The heart as understanding and inner awareness supplies the site at which recollection occurs.
Agitation supplies the somatic cost of involuntary disclosure.
Acting blind to something supplies a live image of prior concealment or refusal to see.
Bringing a thing out of hiding supplies the counter-movement into disclosure.
Compulsion and being driven to necessity make the disclosure nonoptional.
Recovering what was forgotten supplies the cognitive content forced back into the heart.
Appearance and uncovering externalize what can no longer remain hidden.
Actual sight completes the movement from inward concealment to visible confrontation.

structural_cues: 79:29 coordinates darkening night with bringing out brightness; 79:35-36 similarly coordinate remembering with exposure to sight.
The repeated يوم in 79:35 returns to the day named deictically in the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies darkening, extraction from hiding, compulsory arrival, recollection, exposure, and sight; I infer one concealment-to-disclosure mechanism and locate its shock in the heart. A live alternative is that the cosmic light sequence and judgment disclosure are parallel but causally independent.

changed_reading.before: The heart shakes because it anticipates something frightening.
changed_reading.after: The heart shakes as its own concealed or forgotten knowledge is forcibly turned into memory and visible confrontation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The created order is assembled, raised, structurally supported, made even, massed into solidity, and anchored. Read back against that material stability, the quivering قلب is the human core that cannot hold equilibrium when the decisive day arrives.

activation_trace.role: The pure inner core supplies the human structure's center rather than only an emotion-word.
Agitation supplies loss of steadiness at that center.
Joining parts into a construction supplies designed structural order.
Raising supplies the vertical establishment of that order.
A ceiling or support that holds construction supplies sustained structural integrity.
Straightness and completion supply equilibrium and finished form.
A raised solid mass supplies the material extreme of firmness.
Fixity and rootedness supply explicit anchoring against which the heart's motion stands out.

structural_cues: 79:27-33 proceeds from building and leveling above to spreading and anchoring below before the greater event comes.
The focus names a moving center; the creation section repeatedly names stable supports and completed arrangement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a built, balanced, anchored cosmos and a disturbed human core; I infer a microcosmic contrast in which inner equilibrium fails despite remembered external order. A live alternative is that the creation section proves power without commenting on the physiology of 79:8.

changed_reading.before: The heart's motion is only an emotion of fear.
changed_reading.after: The human core loses structural equilibrium against a context of deliberately built and anchored stability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus locates wajf at يومئذ, while the ending asks for the hour's mooring, assigns its endpoint elsewhere, and collapses lived duration to an evening or morning. Wajf-speed thus becomes temporal as well as cardiac: the center races when ordinary measures of waiting, arrival, and duration lose their anchor.

activation_trace.role: Rapid travel supplies the felt acceleration used to model temporal disorientation.
Turning from one state to another supplies the center crossing between temporal frames.
A vessel's stopping and mooring supply the requested but unavailable temporal anchor.
The limit at which something ends supplies the hour's terminal boundary.
A duration of time supplies the interval that perception will radically compress.
Remaining in a place supplies the ordinary persistence that the final comparison negates.
Evening time supplies one short boundary for the retrospectively collapsed interval.
The morning's extension supplies the alternate short boundary for that collapse.

structural_cues: The focus's يومئذ and the closing يوم يرونها frame the whole-surah package with deictic day expressions.
The question أَيَّانَ and the evening-or-morning comparison move from demanded dating to radically compressed retrospect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unmoored hour, a divinely held endpoint, denied lingering, and short day-parts; I infer that wajf's speed figures the subject's loss of temporal scale. A live alternative is that the ending corrects chronology without coloring the heart's motion.

changed_reading.before: The hearts race during a frightening dated event.
changed_reading.after: The hearts race as ordinary temporal anchoring collapses: the awaited endpoint arrives and the long interval contracts to part of a day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the heart as a resonant receiver and links events across narrative sections; it remains anchored in wajf's literal agitation and in packet-backed severe shaking, rebuking sound, raised call, and warning. Downstream prose should present acoustic transmission as a reader-supplied mechanism, not as the lexical translation of وَاجِفَة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَاجِفَة supplies a physically agitated heart capable of registering repeated sound and shock.

activation_trace.role: The bodily heart supplies the medium in which external impulses can become palpitation.
Physical agitation supplies the resonant response rather than a purely conceptual fear.
Severe shaking supplies the low-frequency shock that begins the resonant sequence.
Forceful rebuke by sound supplies a concentrated vocal impulse.
Raising the voice in a call extends the pattern of consequential sound.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the final communicative impulse reaching a fear-capable heart.

changed_reading.after: The heart behaves as a resonant chamber in which the surah's shocks, cry, calls, and warning become bodily vibration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the relevant wajf image comes from the causative expression in which love carries a heart away, not directly from the adjectival form in 79:8. It remains worth carrying because the focus explicitly pairs heart and wajf, while later preference and self-inclination supply an affective vector. Downstream prose must label it an exploratory activation about prior capture by desire, never a replacement translation for وَاجِفَة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُلُوب beside وَاجِفَة reproduces the two lexical participants in the branch image of affect taking the heart away.

activation_trace.role: The affective heart supplies the object that can be seized or carried by desire.
Love taking the heart away supplies the form-distant model of affective capture.
Choosing one thing over another supplies the act by which the lower life gains priority.
The self's inclination supplies the affective force imagined as carrying the heart away.

changed_reading.before: The final encounter newly causes fear in an otherwise neutral heart.
changed_reading.after: The quivering may expose a heart that had already been carried by its chosen inclination and now confronts the result of that capture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the qalab mold branch behind the plural قُلُوب and converts creation language into an analogy for interior formation. It remains anchored by the exact focus root and by packet-backed measuring, building, and completing images, but the nominal distance is substantial. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy for destabilized formed identity, not claim that قُلُوب literally means molds here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ق ل ب inventory includes the mold into which material is poured, while وَاجِفَة supplies disturbance of what normally holds form.

activation_trace.role: A casting mold supplies a material analogy for the formed interior identity named by the heart.
Agitation supplies destabilization of that form-bearing interior.
Measuring and proportioning supply the prior act of giving a thing determinate form.
Joining parts into a construction supplies assembled form.
Straightness and completion supply the finished state that the shaking mold analogy puts under pressure.

changed_reading.before: A preformed person merely experiences fear.
changed_reading.after: The form-bearing interior itself shakes, as though judgment destabilizes the mold of the identity that prior acts had formed.

strongest_changes: The adjacent rajf-following-radf sequence turns wajf into a somatic aftershock rather than isolated fear.
The opening motion chain strengthens the focus root-pair as rapid, directed reorientation.
The return sequence makes the hearts' motion the felt enactment of a reversal previously denied in speech.
Later fear and choice language revises wajf into morally underdetermined activation whose orientation is disclosed by desire or restraint.
Memory, exposure, and sight make the trembling heart a site of forced disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly changed the scale and function of one compact body image: cosmic shaking became cardiac aftershock, processional speed became interior transition, return became enacted reversal, and later ethical and temporal structures prevented fear from collapsing into a single verdict.
remaining_uncertainties: The kinetic reading of وَاجِفَة is branch-backed but may function only as resonance with the opening sequence rather than as an active shade in the focus form.
The moral-pivot model leaves open whether the indefinite hearts are deliberately broad or pragmatically limited to one outcome-group.
The temporal-unmooring and material mold readings depend on reader-supplied cross-domain arrows and should remain qualified.
The affective-capture branch is morphologically more distant than the direct palpitation branch.
